Same shared cause likely explains many records; not 108 independent roots.

root_cause_clusters.minimal_fix: Add reusable exact state shapes to compute_shape for missing families; use fixtures rather than per-block overrides.
root_cause_clusters.test: Compare official shape fixtures for witness + adjacent states, then center and edge landing; full-cube control.

root_cause_clusters.finding: 112 report-confirmed picking differences are mostly foreground selected instead of background. outline_shape falls back to full cube; source TODO explicitly notes small flowers/plants/torches/buttons/redstone. Keep outline distinct from collision where vanilla differs.
root_cause_clusters.current_status: Static gap likely; raycast not retested.

root_cause_clusters.test: Replay witness front/background camera coordinates; assert target hit and actual break, plus through-empty-outline tests.

root_cause_clusters.finding: Report image comparison: skeleton skull body absent. Current renderer registers Skull with bake_player_head_model and Steve sheet; variant_for_block only distinguishes player_wall_head. Static model/texture mismatch candidate, not runtime verification.
root_cause_clusters.current_status: Static source mismatch suspected; do not call fixed.
root_cause_clusters.minimal_fix: Select skull-family models/textures separately from player profile skin; preserve player head profile path.
root_cause_clusters.test: Normal-render screenshots for skeleton/wither/zombie/creeper/player skulls, standing rotation and wall-facing; test player profile fallback.

root_cause_clusters.finding: Shulker opacity, slime transparency, soul campfire smoke, and banner body are separate fixture-specific symptoms; single captures do not prove a shared cause or total subsystem failure.
root_cause_clusters.test: Repeat exact fixture; multi-frame capture for smoke; check blend/depth and visibility.

root_cause_clusters.finding: Three confirmed report records: repeating command block editor, smithing table, stonecutter menu do not open in Pomme; separate from shape/raycast findings.
root_cause_clusters.minimal_fix: Trace player interaction dispatch and inbound menu packets/screens for these block IDs.
root_cause_clusters.test: 150ms right click; assert expected editor/menu type; controls chest and crafting table.

notes: Source records cover 229/229. All are recorded as observed/confirmed runtime differences; none in this subset are labeled invalid or uncertain.
